close_reason: Implemented the user-approved immutable GitHub dependency in CLI commit 6e7400a. Jidoka commit 23bd10ff is on GitHub. Local and isolated checks pass; no Hex release was published.
description:
## Outcome

A clean `jido_cli` checkout resolves one exact Jidoka commit from GitHub. It does not need the sibling `../jidoka` checkout or a Jidoka Hex release.

## Implemented contract

- The default dependency is `agentjido/jidoka` at full commit `23bd10ffc822935c06395e34301d63c249e5cbe3`.
- `mix.lock` records the same immutable Git source and commit.
- `JIDO_CLI_JIDOKA_PATH` is an explicit development/test-only local override. Production rejects it.
- Unused lock entries were removed.
- The public Jidoka source-boundary test remains active.
- An isolated Git worktree with no sibling Jidoka repository passes dependency resolution, compile, 189 tests, and docs.

## Non-goals

Do not publish Jidoka or `jido_cli` to Hex. Do not use a moving Git branch or tag.
title: Use an immutable GitHub Jidoka dependency
